---
title: "Visuals"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Task - 1
# =========================================================

# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. LOAD ALL CSV FILES
# ---------------------------------------------------------
path <- "/VDS2526_Madrid"

files <- list.files(path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
df <- files %>%
  map_dfr(read_csv)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. PREPARE DATA
# ---------------------------------------------------------
df$date <- ymd_hms(df$date)
df$year <- year(df$date)

pollutants <- c(
  "NMHC", "CH4", "CO", "SO_2", "NO",
  "NO_2", "PM25", "NOx", "O_3", "TOL",
  "BEN", "EBE", "MXY", "PXY", "OXY",
  "TCH", "PM10"
)

yearly_avg <- df %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(across(
    all_of(pollutants),
    ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -year,
    names_to  = "pollutant",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.), NA, .))) %>%
  drop_na()

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. SPLIT POLLUTANTS BY SCALE
# ---------------------------------------------------------
group1 <- c("NMHC", "CH4", "CO") # mg/m³
group2 <- c(
  "SO_2", "NO", "NO_2", "PM25", "NOx", "O_3",
  "TOL", "BEN", "EBE", "MXY", "PXY", "OXY", "TCH"
) # µg/m³
group3 <- c("PM10") # unknown scale

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. COLOUR PALETTE
# ---------------------------------------------------------
all_pollutants <- c(group1, group2, group3)
palette_vals <- c(
  "#3266ad", "#d85a30", "#1d9e75", "#c94b8e", "#73726c",
  "#ba7517", "#534ab7", "#185fa5", "#993c1d", "#0f6e56",
  "#3b6d11", "#a32d2d", "#854f0b", "#1d9e75", "#d85a30",
  "#3266ad", "#c94b8e"
)
color_map <- setNames(palette_vals[seq_along(all_pollutants)], all_pollutants)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. HELPER: BUILD ONE PLOT WITH ALL POLLUTANTS IN A GROUP
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_group_plot <- function(data, pollutant_group, y_title) {
  p <- plot_ly()

  for (pol in pollutant_group) {
    d <- data %>% filter(pollutant == pol)
    p <- add_trace(
      p,
      x = d$year,
      y = d$value,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      name = pol,
      line = list(color = color_map[pol], width = 2),
      marker = list(color = color_map[pol], size = 6),
      legendgroup = pol,
      hovertemplate = paste0(
        "<b>", pol, "</b><br>",
        "Year: %{x}<br>",
        "Value: %{y:.2f} ", y_title,
        "<extra></extra>"
      )
    )
  }
  p
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. BUILD THE 3 INDIVIDUAL PLOTS
# ---------------------------------------------------------
p1 <- make_group_plot(yearly_avg, group1, "mg/m³")
p2 <- make_group_plot(yearly_avg, group2, "µg/m³")
p3 <- make_group_plot(yearly_avg, group3, "µg/m³")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. COMBINE INTO ONE FIGURE WITH 3 SUBPLOTS (side by side)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
fig <- subplot(p1, p2, p3,
  nrows       = 1,
  shareX      = FALSE,
  shareY      = FALSE,
  titleX      = TRUE,
  titleY      = TRUE,
  margin      = 0.05
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 8. LAYOUT
# ---------------------------------------------------------
fig <- fig %>%
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = "<b>Air Pollution Yearly Averages — Madrid (2001–2018)</b>",
      font = list(size = 16),
      x    = 0.5
    ),
    hovermode = "x",
    legend = list(
      orientation = "v",
      x           = 1.01,
      y           = 1,
      font        = list(size = 11)
    ),
    # x-axes
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Year", tickangle = -45, dtick = 1,
      tickfont = list(size = 9)
    ),
    xaxis2 = list(
      title = "Year", tickangle = -45, dtick = 1,
      tickfont = list(size = 9)
    ),
    xaxis3 = list(
      title = "Year", tickangle = -45, dtick = 1,
      tickfont = list(size = 9)
    ),
    # y-axes
    yaxis = list(title = "mg/m³"),
    yaxis2 = list(title = "µg/m³"),
    yaxis3 = list(title = "µg/m³"),
    paper_bgcolor = "white",
    plot_bgcolor = "white",
    font = list(family = "Arial, sans-serif")
  ) %>%
  config(
    displayModeBar = TRUE,
    modeBarButtonsToRemove = c("select2d", "lasso2d"),
    toImageButtonOptions = list(
      format   = "png",
      filename = "air_pollution_madrid",
      width    = 1800,
      height   = 600,
      scale    = 2
    )
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 9. DISPLAY
# ---------------------------------------------------------
fig

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 10. SAVE AS STANDALONE HTML
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# saveWidget(fig, "air_pollution_interactive.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
```
